title: 第七十二章 亡命啸聚劫尘尽 十一功满证红尘第七十一章 朔风卷地凝寒雪 万里冰封第十灾
content_zh:
诗曰：
天灾十重尽归休，人世余殃尚未收。
饥馑逼生豺虎性，刀兵再起乱荒州。
大雪初晴，万里冰封。十重天灾尽数消歇，风雨、旱火、山崩、洪蝗、疫寒皆已终章。
天地复静，却人心未静。
连年大劫，九州赤地千里、粮米绝尽、村落残破、百姓饥寒入骨。活下来的人，熬过天灾，熬不过人欲。
荒山野岭之间，无数流民走投无路，弃善从恶，结伙为盗、聚啸成寇。
昔日良民，今朝亡命；昔日耕夫，今朝持刀。
此乃红尘第十一重，终极大劫——盗寇乱世劫。
六道圣尊历十重天地浩劫，道心澄澈，布衣立在雪原高冈，俯瞰苍茫荒州。四野死寂，唯余山道隐隐有杀伐之声远远传来。
何日迎风而立，衣衫犹带雪霜，沉声吟道：
“天灾历尽地安宁，孰料人心再起兵。
最险从来非造化，世间贪恶最难平。
原来天地诸灾，皆为外厄；唯有人心贪杀，是红尘终极内魔。”
白洁眉目沉静，看透乱世根由，缓缓言道：
“十劫磨尽山河苦，一恶横生乱世殃。
温饱足则人性善，饥寒极则礼义亡。
百姓本良善，奈何连年绝粮、冻馁濒死，绝境逼出豺狼性。此最后一劫，炼的不是体魄，不是眼界，是终极道心。”
何月道：“天灾有尽，人祸无穷。
山可崩、水可竭、火可熄、疫可散，唯独贪嗔杀欲，不死不灭。

今日这最后一难，便是勘破红尘人心终极之恶。过此一关，红尘十二大苦尽数圆满。”
公孙离望着远方山村烟火微弱，轻叹：
“历尽千灾犹未死，人心一动便相残。
原来诸天最大劫，不在天地在尘凡。”
花月步温声定调：
“我等依旧封尽圣力，不用仙法、不镇杀伐、不度亡魂。
只以凡人血肉，护苍生、止凶乱、劝顽恶、守本心。
十一劫过，红尘圆满，道心无漏。”
黄鼬妖紧紧扒住衣襟，小声道：
“天灾都熬完了，偏偏人要害人……真是最可怕的劫难。”
何年目光如渊，朗声道：
“十一终劫至！
外灾十重已满，内恶一难为终。
今日踏平乱世寇乱，看尽人间善恶，自此红尘历劫圆满！
诸位，护民止杀！”
话音未落！
山道尽头，马蹄骤响、喊杀震天！
但见：
豺狼聚众出荒林，利刃寒光映雪深。
破袄狰狞藏恶胆，饥躯悍勇起贪心。

刀挥残户搜粮米，剑指疲民夺布衾。
久困饥寒忘善性，一朝作乱乱千村。
数百亡命盗寇，身披破甲、手持刀枪，自深山老林呼啸杀出！
皆是连年灾荒活下来的精壮流民，无家可归、无粮可食、无路可退，心中再无礼法、再无善念。
他们深知各村百姓劫后孱弱、无兵无械、粮少力微，趁雪后路开，大举劫掠！
content_en:
The poem says:
The ten natural disasters have all come to an end, and the remaining disasters in the world have not yet been collected.
Famine forced the wild and tiger nature to emerge, and weapons and weapons again invaded the desolate state.
The snow clears at the beginning, and thousands of miles are covered with ice. The ten major natural disasters have all subsided. Wind, rain, drought, fire, landslides, floods, locusts, and epidemics and cold have all come to an end.
The world is quiet again, but people's hearts are not.
In successive years of calamity, Kyushu has been devastated for thousands of miles, food and rice are exhausted, villages are in ruins, and the people are hungry and cold to the bone. Those who survived survived natural disasters but not human desires.
Among the barren mountains and ridges, countless refugees are desperate, abandoning good and turning to evil, forming gangs of thieves and bandits.
The good people of the past are now on the run; the plowmen of the past are now armed with swords.
This is the eleventh level of the world of mortals, the ultimate catastrophe - the catastrophe of bandits and bandits.
The Saint of Six Paths has experienced ten catastrophes of heaven and earth, and his Taoist heart is clear. He stands in common clothes on a high hill in the snowy field, overlooking the vast desolate state. The surrounding fields were completely silent, except for the faint sounds of killing coming from afar on the remaining mountain roads.
He stood in the wind one day, his clothes still stained with snow and frost, and said in a deep voice:
“After all the natural disasters, the land has been peaceful, but who would have expected that people’s hearts would rise again.
The most dangerous thing is never fate, and greed and evil are the most difficult to overcome in the world.
It turns out that all disasters in the world are external disasters; only the greed of human heart is the ultimate inner demon in the world of mortals. "
Bai Jie's eyes were calm, she saw through the root cause of the troubled times, and said slowly:
“Ten kalpas have wiped out the mountains and rivers, and one evil act has brought chaos to the world.
If food and clothing are sufficient, human nature will be good; if hunger and cold are extreme, propriety and justice will perish.
The people are good-natured, but they have been without food for years, are dying of cold, and the desperate situation has forced out their wolfish nature. In this last calamity, what is being refined is not the body, nor the vision, but the ultimate Taoist heart. "
He Yue said: "There are endless natural disasters, but there are endless man-made disasters.
Mountains can collapse, water can be exhausted, fire can be extinguished, and epidemics can be dispersed. Only greed, anger, and the desire to kill will never die.
Today's final difficulty is to uncover the ultimate evil in human hearts. After passing this level, all the twelve major sufferings in the human world will be fulfilled. "
Gongsun Li looked at the faint fireworks in the distant mountain villages and sighed:
“After experiencing thousands of disasters and still not dying, people will kill each other at a moment’s notice.
It turns out that the greatest calamity in the world is not in heaven and earth but in the mortal world. "
The warm sound of Huayuebu sets the tone:
"We still seal all the holy power, and we don't use immortal magic, we don't suppress killings, and we don't save the souls of the dead.
Only use mortal flesh and blood to protect the common people, stop evil and chaos, dissuade stubborn evil, and keep one's true heart.
Eleven kalpas have passed, the world of mortals is perfect, and the mind of the Tao is flawless. "
The yellow weasel demon held his clothes tightly and whispered:
"After all the natural disasters, people want to harm others... It's really the most terrible disaster."
He Nian's eyes were as deep as the abyss and he said loudly:
"The eleventh catastrophe has arrived!
The ten levels of external disasters have been completed, and the internal evils are difficult to end.
Today, we have put an end to the chaos in the troubled world, and seen all the good and evil in the world. From now on, the world of mortals will be complete!
Everyone, protect the people and stop the killing! "
The words have not yet been spoken!
At the end of the mountain road, the sound of horse hooves suddenly sounded, and the shouts of killing shook the sky!
But see:
Jackals gathered together and emerged from the wild forest, the cold light of their sharp blades reflected in the deep snow.
The ragged coat hides evil courage, the hungry body is brave and greedy.
The sword was wielded to search for grain and rice from the disabled households, and the sword was pointed at the tired people to seize cloth quilts.
Being trapped, hungry and cold for a long time, he forgot his good nature, and once in a while he caused chaos and destroyed thousands of villages.
Hundreds of desperate bandits, wearing broken armor and holding swords and guns, roared out of the mountains and forests!
They are all able-bodied refugees who have survived years of famine. They have no home, no food to eat, no way to escape, and no more courtesy or good thoughts in their hearts.
They knew very well that the people in each village were weak, without weapons, and with little food and resources after the robbery, so they took advantage of the snow to open up a road and looted on a large scale!
